hooks.command: input=$(cat); echo "$input" >> /tmp/claude_hook_debug.log; echo "$input" | grep -qi '/gsd' && touch /tmp/claude_gsd_ran || true

if [ -f /tmp/claude_gsd_ran ] && git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" status --porcelain | grep -q .; then rm -f /tmp/claude_gsd_ran; echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"You ran a GSD command and there are uncommitted changes in the working tree. Review the changes and commit any planning artifacts (.planning/) or other intended work before stopping. If the changes should NOT be committed, explain why and stop."}'; else rm -f /tmp/claude_gsd_ran; fi
